clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Good evening. If you can hear this, do not adjust your set. We have already adjusted our expectations.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: Hello? Is there actually someone listening?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: A listener. Excellent. Mara is stranded on the other side of our signal. Five questions will determine whether we bring her back before signoff.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: You said that to the last one.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: And I admired their enthusiasm.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: This broadcast is interactive. Type your answer and press Enter. Your time begins when I finish each question. You may pause the broadcast using the button on your screen.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: In standard mode, the first answer window is two seconds. Later windows are four, six, eight, and ten. More time. Fewer excuses.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: Please. Just try.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: We do hate losing people. It complicates the paperwork.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Name a colour.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Give me one number.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Give me one word.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: An answer without the appropriate supporting documentation. A brave opening choice.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Silence. A fascinating submission. Unfortunately, the silence department closed at nine.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: That was an answer. You heard it.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: I hear many things, Mara. Acceptance is a separate service.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Question two. Four seconds. We have generously doubled your opportunity to disappoint us.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: What is two plus two?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Can you hear me?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Name any day of the week.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: A technically plausible answer submitted under a rule we have just replaced. Unfortunate timing.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Time expired. We accept late answers, naturally. They simply arrive after the person.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: You never mentioned that rule.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Published rules encourage preparation. We prefer character development.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Six seconds for the next one. Almost enough time to question the institution.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Say something reassuring.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Name something that gives light.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Say one kind thing to Mara.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: A moving sentiment. Sadly, our forms have no field for sincerity.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: A moment of silence. Very respectful. A little early, but remarkably organized.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: Who decides what counts as right?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: An independent panel.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: Who is on it?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: I respect their privacy.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Eight seconds. The panel is optimistic. I can tell.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Which way should Mara go?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: What should we use to open a locked door?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Give me a reason to change the rules.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: A sensible proposal. Sensible proposals are outside the scope of this broadcast.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: No answer. At last, someone has understood our preferred outcome.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: There is no right answer, is there?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: There are many right answers. We simply do not broadcast them.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: Listener. He needs you to keep answering.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: And we appreciate the engagement.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: The final question. Ten whole seconds. A lifetime, depending on your side of the door.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Tell me why Mara deserves to come back.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Say Mara’s name.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Tell me what you want this station to do.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: The panel has reviewed your final answer and found it dangerously close to a solution. Rejected.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Ten seconds, and still no acceptable answer. The silence will fit beautifully in our closing credits.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: You promised.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: I promised five questions. We pride ourselves on delivery.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: That is our time. Please remain on the line while the line ceases to exist.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: Listener. You answered. He just kept moving the door.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: We call that an adaptive entrance policy.

clips.speaker: captive
clips.text: If anyone asks what happened, tell them I was here.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Mara?

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: No response. Another listener, another beautifully completed form.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Five questions answered. None acceptable. Please take a moment to reflect on your contribution.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: You have been listening to Channel Zero. If the dark calls back, do let it finish speaking.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Your feedback is important to us. Our capacity to act on it remains theoretical.
